chapter: Barnet, 52nd Street and New York recording dates
title: New York as the center of everything; small-group record dates
summary: Everything happened in New York, and he first recorded with small groups with Dizzy, Parker and Don Byas.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: But New York was a fun spot. This was a fun place. You wouldn't want to be anywhere else then because everything happened there. And all the bands that were on the road, they were just aching to get back to New York, not to make money, but where all the action was, you know? And it was really there.

And there was an awful lot of recording going on then and even later on, where little groups would get together and record. You know, that's the first time I was recording with little groups, with Dizzy, myself, Charlie Parker, Don Byas. Some guy would just call us to come make a record, and we'd go make these record dates at that time.
